# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old by the end of Volume 4  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v3 c39 P3](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0003)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029)</sub>
- **Status:** Single (engaged/courted by Ralph Andrews)  <sub>[v3 c39 P3](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0003)</sub>
- **Origin:** East Grafton, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Student / Farm housewife-in-training  <sub>[v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c7 P34](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0034)</sub>

## Appearance

Dora is a fair-complexioned girl with long, sleek hazel curls that never get out of order, gentle hazel eyes, a straight nose, and a prim, neat mouth. She is known for her remarkably tidy, starched appearance, though she has a tendency to plumpness.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P5](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0005), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Dora is quiet, demure, obedient, and exceptionally well-behaved to the point of being monotonous. She is very timid, orderly, and careful, always doing what she is told without complaint. Unlike her twin brother Davy, she lacks a sense of mischief or imagination, preferring neatness, routine, and propriety.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P12](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0012), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089)_

## Traits

- Prim and proper  <sub>[v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)</sub>
- Timid and easily frightened  <sub>[v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c10 P28](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0028), [v2 c21 P4](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0004)</sub>
- Neat and methodical  <sub>[v2 c7 P29](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0029), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>
- Obedient  <sub>[v2 c7 P29](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0029), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030)</sub>

## Abilities

- Helpful with household chores and gardening  <sub>[v2 c7 P34](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0034), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>
- Hand-sewing and needlework  <sub>[v2 c7 P34](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0034)</sub>

## Goals

- To be a good, obedient child and maintain neatness  <sub>[v2 c8 P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003), [v3 c13 P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037)</sub>

## History

Following the death of her mother in East Grafton, Dora and her twin brother Davy were taken in by Marilla Cuthbert and Anne Shirley at Green Gables. While her brother Davy was constantly getting into trouble, Dora was a model of good behavior, helping Marilla and Anne around the house and keeping her clothes clean. She began attending Avonlea school at seven years old. When her uncle Richard Keith died, he left a trust fund for her and Davy, securing their stay at Green Gables permanently. As she grew into her teens, she inherited the porch gable room at Green Gables after Anne left for college, and eventually began being courted by Ralph Andrews.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c8 P0](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0000), [v2 c8 P48](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0048), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c22 P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v3 c4 P2](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0002), [v3 c39 P3](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0003)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of Mary Keith and a third cousin of Marilla Cuthbert's  <sub>[v2 c1 P29](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0029), [v2 c1 P35](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0035)</sub>
- Has a twin brother named Davy  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Father died when she was a baby and her mother died of a long illness when Dora was six years old  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P22](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0022)</sub>
